title: Uniqueness and non-uniquess for the mean field control of fisheries
summary: We study a Mean Field Control system arising in the management of fisheries with a special emphasis on non-uniqueness issues. Namely, we focus on a situation where a group of players coordinate in order to harvest a fishery in the most efficient way possible. A major challenge in such modelling is the coupling between the dynamics of fish population, which we model through a reaction-diffusion equation, and that of the players, which is seen through the lens of Mean Field Control.
